senses.gloss:
‘kośa(ṣa)karaka(kāraka)’
earlier name of Saṅghabhadra's Nyāyānusāra, a critique of Vasubandhu's Abhidharmakośa.
See Nyāyānusāra.

‘kośalāgama’
jy.-architecture. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 30. Gough p. 33. L. 771. RASB. III. 2822 (Kośalāgama is itself cited herein).
--Gṛhaprakaraṇa from. RASB. III. 2823.
